explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/802: Alon proved the conjectured bound 'replacing the K_r-free assumption with the stronger assumption that the induced graph on every vertex neighbourhood has chromatic number ≤ r−2'. The Lean statement: ∀ r, ∃ c > 0, ∀ n and G on Fin n such that every induced neighbourhood graph G.induce (G.neighborSet v) is (r−2)-colourable, c·(log t / t)·n ≤ indepNum G. For r ≤ 2 the truncated r − 2 = 0 forces all neighbourhoods to be empty, i.e. an edgeless graph, where the bound is trivial. Faithful.
